text.description: Optional review text. When provided, must be non-empty after trimming.

images.description: Optional attached images: an optional primary image plus up to 4 secondary images (5 total). Images are independently addable/removable.

rating.description: Scale-relative rating value. Valid range depends on ratingScale: 1-5 for 1 (whole stars), 1-10 for 2 (half stars), 1-20 for 4 (quarter stars). Interpretation: stars = rating / ratingScale. Runtime validation MUST enforce per-scale limits.

language.description: Optional language code the review text is written in, if different from or more specific than the actor's default language.

createdAt.description: Canonical UTC instant serialized as ISO 8601 with a trailing Z suffix.

updatedAt.description: Canonical UTC instant serialized as ISO 8601 with a trailing Z suffix.

reviewCopy.description: True when the posted review discloses that the actor received or owns a review copy of this work or edition.

ratingScale.description: The rating granularity divisor used at write time: divide rating by this value to recover stars. 1 = whole stars, 2 = half stars, 4 = quarter stars. Reflects whichever scale was in effect the last time rating was written on this record.

catalogTarget.description: The work and edition that this review is about. Mutable.

catalogSnapshot.description: Point-in-time catalog metadata for the reviewed work or edition, captured when this record was last written. Refreshed on every update.

main.description: A review of one edition by an actor. Duplicate convention: the rkey is a TID minted once at first create and never changes. Several records may exist for one actor and edition (for example from out-of-band writers); consumers SHOULD treat the record with the greatest `updatedAt` (falling back to `createdAt`) as the winner and break ties by the lowest TID, ignoring the others. This is a convention, not an enforced contract: AppViews MUST tolerate a differing winner, and may see a record's catalogTarget change over time.
